rule: Every still needs a DISTINCT place matching the spoken beat, visible wardrobe color change vs previous still, and other people when the story is social.

beats.environment: crowded house-party living room, warm string lights, host pressed against the wall while the room feels threatening
beats.people: many soft-focus guests laughing and mingling in groups behind and beside her — she is clearly not alone
beats.action: clutching her sleeve, scanning the room as if every corner is unsafe
beats.lighting: warm party bokeh with uneven social lighting

beats.environment: outside a small neighborhood cafe entrance on a quiet street, low-stakes public setting
beats.people: two pedestrians walking past and a customer exiting the cafe door in soft focus
beats.action: standing on the sidewalk preparing for a tiny exposure, notebook half-open

beats.environment: calm indie bookstore aisle, quiet personality feels okay here
beats.people: one distant shopper browsing shelves in soft focus
beats.action: browsing a book calmly, shoulders relaxed compared to threat scenes

beats.environment: busy cafe seating area where ordinary social moments feel like threat
beats.people: a small group at a nearby table mid-conversation, one person glancing toward her
beats.action: frozen mid-step, avoiding joining the conversation, eyes flicking away

beats.environment: packed living-room party near a lit EXIT doorway
beats.people: blurred guests chatting in clusters; someone by the snack table
beats.action: half-turned toward the exit while fake-laughing too quickly, phone half-raised

beats.environment: narrow office hallway after a hard social moment, shield metaphor via closed-off body
beats.people: two coworkers walking past in soft focus, still present in the corridor
beats.action: holding an invisible emotional shield posture, learning blocked

beats.environment: cafe table during an awkward silence in a conversation
beats.people: a friend or acquaintance sitting across from her waiting; other patrons softly blurred
beats.action: eyes dropping to phone the second silence hits, escaping the pause
beats.lighting: warm cafe practicals, phone screen glow on her face

beats.environment: bathroom mirror before re-entering a lounge, sticky mental scripts
beats.people: through the open door, soft-focus people socializing in the lounge beyond
beats.action: rehearsing sentences under her breath at the mirror, missing real connection

beats.environment: standing networking circle at a workplace mixer / glass meeting lobby
beats.people: three colleagues in the circle facing her; more attendees blurred behind
beats.action: stiff performed smile, shoulders up, voice forced while still self-monitoring

beats.environment: evening bar or casual hangout, she only came with armor
beats.people: a buddy standing as a shield beside her; crowded bar patrons behind them
beats.action: half-hiding behind the buddy with a drink in hand, not true exposure
beats.lighting: dim warm bar neon and practicals

beats.environment: short bookstore checkout line — mild 3–4/10 social difficulty, not a wedding speech
beats.people: one cashier and one customer ahead in line, clearly present
beats.action: waiting in line ready to drop one small shield

beats.environment: workplace elevator interior as a low-stakes exposure place she already uses
beats.people: two other riders standing quietly in the elevator with her
beats.action: choosing this everyday place for a sixty-second practice

beats.environment: cafe counter ledge / small standing table before ordering
beats.people: barista behind the counter and one customer in queue, soft focus
beats.action: writing one fear prediction line in a pocket notebook

beats.environment: office hallway crossing paths with a coworker
beats.people: a coworker approaching for a brief greeting — must be visible and in-focus enough to read the hello
beats.action: short eye contact and a clear hello / nod without phone shield

beats.environment: staying inside the elevator after the tiny hello, not rushing away
beats.people: the same two riders still present; she remains for the full minute
beats.action: standing still, noticing what actually happened instead of catastrophizing

beats.environment: cafe table after the micro-exposure, writing one outcome fact
beats.people: other patrons in background; the person she greeted may be visible leaving or at counter
beats.action: writing a factual outcome line, not a pep talk

beats.environment: city sidewalk bench outside the cafe after the practice
beats.people: passersby in soft focus keeping the world populated
beats.action: closing the notebook with quiet relief — one dropped shield, one note

beats.environment: morning street near work — small daily reps, not one brave night a year
beats.people: commuters and a street vendor soft in background
beats.action: walking into the day ready for another same-size practice

beats.environment: simple cream teaching set inviting a comment, still story-linked
beats.people: none required — direct to camera; optional tiny soft silhouette of a prior social scene in a framed picture behind her
beats.action: asking which safety habit they drop first

beats.environment: calm therapy office with armchair and soft sage tones — educational disclaimer
beats.people: a clinician silhouette or soft-focus therapist figure across from empty chair optional; keep respectful and non-diagnostic
beats.action: sincere disclaimer gesture toward getting qualified help if severe

beats.environment: two-person cafe conversation that became a performance review
beats.people: the other person sitting across from her, clearly present and waiting
beats.action: stuck in her head drafting lines while the other person is right there

beats.environment: dense social gathering, host on the edge not mingling
beats.people: dozens of soft-focus guests filling the frame behind her
beats.action: observing from the wall, overwhelmed by the crowd

beats.environment: open-plan office with desks and monitors
beats.people: several coworkers at desks and one standing conversation nearby
beats.action: navigating a normal work social moment

cafe.environment: busy cafe interior with counters and tables
cafe.people: barista and seated customers in soft focus

office.people: coworkers at desks in soft focus

hallway.environment: workplace hallway with doors and windows

home.people: alone unless beat needs a video-call face on a laptop

bathroom_mirror.environment: bathroom mirror with lounge visible through door
